findings: The durable causal account amendment ebbba65207efec6e78ce8f67fd5b8d73a29dd366 predates immutable production commit 747e138f16209ae693d693722ab6ec61d0655efd. The Java checkout is exactly 71806a23780b04a5ccde2f8ceb5121edad5eb711 and the pinned JAR hash matches the prior checker.

All eight fresh sources are valid PlantUML SEQUENCE diagrams. Their Java SVGs are well-formed and contain no PlantUML error markers.

Three of eight fresh perturbations pass exactly: reverse source-circle plus cross targets in both spatial directions, hidden-footbox caption/footer with default metrics, and hidden-footbox caption/footer with Monospaced metrics.
Five of eight fresh perturbations fail. Three failures directly disprove the claimed generative model independently of the broader Serif metrics issue.

CommandArrow lines 214-222 treats left slash and backslash dressings as reverseDefine even without a less-than sign, then swaps semantic participants at lines 234-242. Rust parse_arrow lines 1098-1109 derives reverse solely from less-than syntax. Valid /-o, \-o, and //-o messages therefore retain the wrong semantic participant order and misplace their source circle and half target dressing.

MessageExoArrow lines 84-116 selects the participant's live segment through LivingParticipantBox.getLiveThicknessAt at the exact arrow ordinate. The fresh shared-border matrices expose five-pixel errors in both directions after depth changes, including opposite-sign errors on the same right border. The scalar event replay still does not model Java's segment selection consistently.

CommandAutonumber passes the complete format to DecimalFormat, and DottedNumber.format returns its full literal result. Rust parse_autonumber_template_runs lines 2466-2473 preserves an angle token only when every character is 0 or #. A valid prefixed numeric token such as <ID-00000> is still discarded as unknown markup.

The hidden-footbox chrome formula generalizes for both default sans and Monospaced metrics. The visible Serif perturbation does not: every physical-font metric and both bottom baselines diverge. This is not the sole basis for rejection, but it disproves the account's broad physical-font acceptance axis.
